Glossary / Demerger (spin-off)
Glossary · Corporate finance

Demerger (spin-off) डीमर्जर (स्पिन-ऑफ़)

Separating a division into its own company, with existing shareholders usually receiving shares in it.

हिंदी में: डीमर्जर (स्पिन-ऑफ़)

किसी डिवीज़न को अलग कंपनी बनाना, जिसमें मौजूदा शेयरधारकों को आमतौर पर उसके शेयर मिलते हैं।

How it is used in the lessons

Demerger: you keep the parent's shares and receive shares of the new company.
